rules: Unknown language can begin untranslated or analysis_required.
More samples and reciprocal interaction improve translation state causally.
Perfect grammar does not imply correct cultural pragmatics.
A civilization may use multiple languages; translating one does not expose all.
Writing-system decoding is separate from spoken translation.
Misunderstanding may occur without either side being irrational or deceptive.
Translation matrices persist and improve; they do not reroll between conversations.
